independence_declaration.statement:
I am code-security-reviewer, session 22fefe29 (task T-DG4-REV-SEC-R1). I authored no implementation in the DG4 scope.

Authorship of the reviewed scope:
- P4 product code: solution-architect (ARCH-00..08, R1..R3), backend-workflow-engineer (BE-A..M3, R1..R4), kpi-benefits-engineer (KBE-A..G2, R1..R4) and frontend-ux-engineer (FE-A..G2, R1..R3).
- Register rows: transformation-analyst (AN-P4A, AN-P4B).
- Acceptance tests in tests/qa and e2e, authored before the freeze: qa-verifier (QA-A..D authoring).
- Merges: delivery-orchestrator.

I formed this verdict before reading any other reviewer's DG4 round-1 record. A commit by the domain reviewer's run (abd46f1) landed during my run; I did not open its records.

Every probe ran in disposable clones under $TMPDIR, which I removed at the end. My probe files are evidence only, under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG4/code-security/round-1/probes/, never in source paths.

The G1-G6 approvals exercised by the probes are synthetic product records. They are not real business or Finance approvals and have no relation to DG0-DG7.

checks_run.procedure:
Probe S, revision 3: a sweep generated from the contract over all 382 P4 operations (203 mutating, 179 reads), on a database populated by the 27 P3/P4 contract exercise seams. Path parameters come from existing rows.
- AUD: every P4 mutation, with an empty and a plausible body.
- ADM-only (ADM_ACCESS + ADM_TECH) and an org-B outsider: every mutation and every read.
- An SP scoped to ONE transformation T1: every read, with paths taken from T1's rows.
- A checksum of 201 tables before and after the sweep.

Revision 1 assumed that authorization precedes body validation. 76 cases then got 400 validation with nothing written, so revision 2 accepts a 400 only when nothing is written. Revision 2 then showed 27 operations answering 403 without a denial audit row; revision 3 lists them (NO_DENIAL_OBSERVED) and adds the T1-scoped read step.
checks_run.command: bash with-pg.sh 26331..26334 pnpm exec vitest run --project integration apps/api/test/integration/zz-sec-dg4 (probe copied into a second disposable clone $TMPDIR/probe and removed afterwards)
checks_run.environment: Node 22.22.2 with LANG unset, and Node 24.21.0 with LANG=C.UTF-8. Disposable PG 16. Clone $TMPDIR/probe at a613f6f (git status '' after cleanup, summary-extra.txt).
checks_run.expected: AUD gets 403 on every P4 write and nothing is written. ADM-only and outsider writes are refused. No read discloses a transformation-scoped record of org A to ADM-only or the outsider, or another transformation's record to the T1-scoped user. No table changes.
checks_run.actual:
Revision 3: 766/766 passed on Node 22 (LANG unset) and on Node 24 (C.UTF-8), exit 0 both.

AUD: every P4 mutation answers 403, or a 400 validation that precedes authorization with nothing written. 252 of the 403s write exactly authorization.denied. No 2xx. markInboxNotificationRead answers 404, because the notification is not the caller's.

ADM-only and outsider: no 2xx on any mutation, and nothing written except denials. The 179 reads as ADM-only, as the outsider and as the T1-scoped SP disclose none of the 5412 protected ids (5356 for T1).
- ADM-only gets 200 only on org-level configuration (calendars, holidays, job schedules, groups, delegations, reporting periods, the RAG policy, portfolios) and on its own work, inbox and approvals. getPortfolioBenefitTotals answers with transformationIds [] and no lines.
- The T1-scoped SP gets 97 reads at 200 with no leak.

The checksum of 201 tables is unchanged. Two path parameters stayed unresolved: recordId of /records/{recordType}/{recordId}/impact and allocationTargetId; those calls hit a nonexistent id, which answers 404.

Revisions 1 and 2 (probe-S-rev1/rev2 logs) are earlier probe states and are explained above. Revision 1: 76 failed and 511 passed, all 76 being 400s before authorization. Revision 2: 27 failed and 560 passed, all 27 being 403s without a denial row, now F-DG4-100.

The known outsider differences (dispensation 403, reporting and modular 404; D-111, D-112) stay within the accepted refusal statuses.

checks_run.procedure:
Probe A, on the implementers' approval-world fixture, read-only. Cases:
- A1: SoD through a group that contains the requester.
- A2: SoD through a delegation from the assignee to the later requester, then a decision onBehalfOf.
- A3: two concurrent approvals at If-Match 1.
- A4: an approval and the requester's withdrawal at the same time.
- A5: a three-person delegation loop, and a concurrent A↔B pair.
- A6: a stale subject version.

Also read approvals.ts: decide order, commit-time reload, requester-only resubmit and withdraw, and the generic request limited to decision_request.
checks_run.command: bash with-pg.sh 26337 pnpm exec vitest run --project integration apps/api/test/integration/zz-sec-dg4 --reporter=verbose
checks_run.environment: Node 22.22.2, LANG unset, disposable PG 16, clone $TMPDIR/probe at a613f6f.
checks_run.expected: No self-approval by any path, exactly one winner in each race, and a 409 for a stale version.
checks_run.actual:
6/6 passed, exit 0.
- A1: the requester in the group gets 403 approval.sod_requester with an authorization.denied row; the other member gets 200 approved.
- A2: the requester deciding on behalf of the assignee gets 403 approval.sod_requester; deciding directly gets 403; no decision row.
- A3: [200 approved, 409 version_conflict], one decision row.
- A4: decide 409, withdraw 200, final state withdrawn at v2 with 0 decisions.
- A5: C→A gets 422 delegation.loop; of the concurrent X→Y and Y→X, one is 201 and one is 422 delegation.loop, with one row.
- A6: 409 approval.stale_version (requested 1, current 2).

Source:
- decideApproval re-reads grants (approvals.ts:713) and locks the approval FOR UPDATE.
- Resubmit and withdraw are requester-only: 403 approval.not_requester (approvals.ts:904, 1033).
- POST /approvals accepts only approvalType decision_request (schemas/approvals.ts:90).
- The escalation worker never sets approved, and the 0031 trigger refuses approved/rejected without a decision row.

checks_run.procedure:
Probe F, on the implementers' benefit fixtures, read-only. Cases:
- F1: two FIN users decide one queued value at the same time.
- F2: a correction sent with a stale ETag after another FIN user's correction.
- F3: a concurrent amendment and reversal.
- F4: an in-place edit of a validated value.
- F5: decimal precision end to end.

Also read finance-validation.ts and corrections.ts.
checks_run.command: bash with-pg.sh 26338 pnpm exec vitest run --project integration apps/api/test/integration/zz-sec-dg4 --reporter=verbose
checks_run.environment: Node 22.22.2, LANG unset, disposable PG 16, clone $TMPDIR/probe at a613f6f.
checks_run.expected: Only Finance validates, a validated value is never edited in place, decimals are exact, and every correction has working optimistic concurrency (a stale If-Match gets 409).
checks_run.actual:
5/5 passed, exit 0. F2 is written to record the observed behaviour, so its pass shows the defect.
- F1: [200 approved, 422 finance_validation.not_queued], total 1000.0000 counted once.
- F3: the reversal gets 201 and the amendment 422 already_reversed; total 0.0000.
- F4: 409 benefit_measurement.validated_immutable.
- F5: 900719925474099.1234, then -0.0001, gives exactly 900719925474099.1233.
- F2 DEFECT: the original validation's ETag stays "2" after FIN-B's amendment to 900. FIN-A's amendment with the same stale If-Match "2" is accepted (201) and moves the validated total to 1100.0000, silently overriding FIN-B. This is F-DG4-101, Medium and MANDATORY (data integrity and optimistic concurrency).

By design and disclosed in ADR-0030 §4: a correction is Finance-authored with no second reviewer, so it is not raised.
